scope: Resumed continuous priority review. Read scopes are selective and exact; retaining a complete body is not a claim that every page was read. All source hashes rechecked. Earlier actual visual receipts retained separately.

retained_primary_bodies.title: CoEulerian graphs
retained_primary_bodies.read: Definitions and least-action interface; Section 2 distinguished-sink/root comparison; Section 3 full NP-membership and binary-multigraph lattice reduction, PDF pp.10–13; Section 3.1/Table 1 historical simple-case question.
retained_primary_bodies.consequence: Prior membership, capacity, root-last method and general binary-multigraph hardness; does not itself give the simple graph reduction.
retained_primary_bodies.edition: arXiv:1502.04690v3, 11 September 2015; no publisher-PDF identity claim

retained_primary_bodies.title: The halting problem for chip-firing on finite directed graphs
retained_primary_bodies.authors: Matthew Farrell; Lionel Levine identified by the title-page footnote as Senior Thesis Advisor
retained_primary_bodies.read: Title-page authorship footnotes; definitions; Sections 1.1 and 4.1, PDF pp.2–3 and 9, complete root-last and congruence interface; Section 4.2, pp.10–11 attempted lattice hardness/numerical gap.
retained_primary_bodies.consequence: Explicit earlier root-last viewpoint and CRT coset computation. Linear congruence solvability differs from Boolean allowed-clause predicates.
retained_primary_bodies.edition: Cornell senior thesis dated 2 December 2014

retained_primary_bodies.title: Linear Extensions of Rotor-Routing in Directed Graphs: Reachability Problems
retained_primary_bodies.authors: David Auger; Pierre Coucheney; Kossi Roland Etse
retained_primary_bodies.read: Actual model definitions, arc/particle legality and conservative VAS interpretation; entire Theorem 21 hardness proof and Lemmas 22–23, PDF pp.39–43, including initial/final arc states, two truth routes and sink targets.
retained_primary_bodies.consequence: Branchable arc-state, exact-target reachability theorem. A containing conservative VAS hardness theorem does not automatically imply ordinary simple conservative HALTING.
retained_primary_bodies.edition: Electronic Journal of Combinatorics 33(2) (2026), P2.5; DOI 10.37236/13580; actual PDF says Published 14 April 2026

retained_primary_bodies.title: Linear Extensions of Rotor-Routing in Directed Graphs: Reachability Problems
retained_primary_bodies.authors: David Auger; Pierre Coucheney; Kossi Roland Etse
retained_primary_bodies.read: Title/version, model and hardness statement/interface cross-check against separately inspected actual journal body.
retained_primary_bodies.consequence: Separate edition corroborates discovery; complete hardness comparison is made to the retained journal PDF, not inferred from title/abstract.
retained_primary_bodies.edition: arXiv:2411.18364v2; title page date and arXiv strip differ; bytes distinct from journal

retained_primary_bodies.title: The Mathematics of Chip-firing
retained_primary_bodies.read: Directed graph stabilization/avalanche finite subsection and PDF p.195 (printed p.185), including Farrell–Levine hardness summary and Eriksson Theorem 6.5.15/construction.
retained_primary_bodies.consequence: Secondary overview for citation-chain discovery and model distinction. Primary FL and Eriksson bodies separately inspected; not an exhaustive read of this 305-page object.
retained_primary_bodies.edition: Retained author-hosted book PDF; no globally current literature claim

retained_primary_bodies.title: Abelian networks II. Halting on all inputs
retained_primary_bodies.read: Network/production/Laplacian definitions; Section 6, Definition 6.5 and Corollary 6.6, complete sandpilization interface and proof, PDF pp.16–18; concluding given-input question.
retained_primary_bodies.consequence: All-input halting preserved by same Laplacian; not arbitrary specified-input/reset-state equivalence. Explicit fresh two-state control rejects only that unsupported shortcut.
retained_primary_bodies.edition: Author-hosted retained PDF; no publisher identity claim

retained_primary_bodies.title: Sandpile Groups
retained_primary_bodies.authors: Luis Garcia Puente; Dino Lorenzini; Criel Merino; David Perkinson; Carlos Enrique Valencia Oleta (workshop report)
retained_primary_bodies.read: Report setup and relevant open-problem/citation portions, including pp.3–4 distinction between divisor/sink settings. Not every problem or cited proof.
retained_primary_bodies.consequence: Historical discovery/context only, not theorem or present-day openness evidence.
retained_primary_bodies.edition: BIRS workshop report, 15–20 November 2015

retained_primary_bodies.title: Some halting problems for abelian sandpiles are undecidable in dimension three
retained_primary_bodies.read: Theorem/initial-configuration interfaces and periodic-plus-finite infinite-grid setup, introductory pp.1–6 and relevant reduction conclusions. Not a recertification of all circuit gadgets.
retained_primary_bodies.consequence: Infinite periodic background decision language, not a finite conservative simple-graph HALTING theorem.
retained_primary_bodies.edition: arXiv:1508.00161v2, byte rechecked via versioned URL

retained_primary_bodies.title: On the complexity of the chip-firing reachability problem
retained_primary_bodies.authors: Bálint Hujter; Viktor Kiss; Lilla Tóthmérész
retained_primary_bodies.read: Graph/configuration conventions, Eulerian and recurrent-target reachability hypotheses, coNP and halting certificate interfaces; selected proofs around pp.8–9 and 12. Root mathematical review independently inspects its used membership interface.
retained_primary_bodies.consequence: Reachability, recurrent target and halting are distinguished; no unproved deterministic target extraction assumed.
retained_primary_bodies.edition: arXiv:1507.03209v4, 4 October 2016

retained_primary_bodies.title: Abelian logic gates
retained_primary_bodies.authors: Alexander E. Holroyd; Lionel Levine; Peter Winkler
retained_primary_bodies.read: Gate/emulation definitions, Section 4 unary base case including full Lemma 4.1 proof on p.15, and entire conservative-gate discussion Section 8.3 on p.32.
retained_primary_bodies.consequence: EXACT bank multiplicity/parallel priming antecedent after f(k)=k+h(0)−h(k). Nonconservative splitter/toppler emulation is distinguished from the candidate physical conserved graph.

retained_primary_bodies.title: Decidability and complexity of Petri net problems – an introduction
retained_primary_bodies.read: Ordinary/1-safe Petri definitions and Section on local conflict-free/free-choice constraints, PDF pp.31–32, relevant complexity interfaces. Not a full read of all 58 pages.
retained_primary_bodies.consequence: Unit and 1-safe hypotheses matter; no arbitrary weighted conservative chip-threshold consequence follows from these inspected interfaces.
retained_primary_bodies.edition: Retained sole-author survey. Original derivation's wording Esparza–Nielsen is corrected in the resumption addendum

retained_primary_bodies.title: Complexity Results for 1-safe Nets
retained_primary_bodies.authors: Allan Cheng; Javier Esparza; Jens Palsberg
retained_primary_bodies.read: Complete set-valued flow, enabling and transition definitions on PDF p.4; relevant class definitions and complexity statements.
retained_primary_bodies.consequence: Unit input/output flow and 1-safe restrictions are not the candidate's weighted degree-threshold conservative net; threshold-one substitution is explicitly invalid.
retained_primary_bodies.edition: Retained author-hosted primary body; full paper not globally recertified

retained_primary_bodies.title: Chip-Firing and Rotor-Routing on Directed Graphs
retained_primary_bodies.authors: Alexander E. Holroyd; Lionel Levine; Karola Mészáros; Yuval Peres; James Propp; David B. Wilson
retained_primary_bodies.read: Definitions on PDF pp.2–3 and least-action/confluence Lemma 2.2/proof interface; sink and rotor state distinctions.
retained_primary_bodies.consequence: Credited prior ordinary-chip dynamics and schedule independence; not a source of simple HALTING hardness by model inclusion.
retained_primary_bodies.edition: arXiv:0801.3306v4 shown in retained title strip

retained_primary_bodies.title: Abelian networks I. Foundations and examples
retained_primary_bodies.read: Network examples, toppling/rotor distinctions, least-action/abelian execution interface relevant to given-input semantics.
retained_primary_bodies.consequence: Prior general least action; no assumption that an arbitrary generalized processor automatically is an ordinary simple conservative chip vertex.
retained_primary_bodies.edition: arXiv:1309.3445v3, versioned byte-equality recheck

retained_primary_bodies.title: Rotor-routing reachability is easy, chip-firing reachability is hard
retained_primary_bodies.read: Entire Claim 2.4 proof, period deletion/bounded games, and full Proposition 2.8 proof, PDF pp.5–7, with linear-equivalence hypotheses.
retained_primary_bodies.consequence: Recurrence reduces to reachability; a recurrent equivalent representative is existentially guessed for a complexity implication, not deterministically produced as a fixed halting input.

retained_primary_bodies.title: Probabilistic and Nondeterministic Unary Automata
retained_primary_bodies.read: Actual title page authorship/pages; complete Fact 3 reconstruction, PDF pp.5–6.
retained_primary_bodies.consequence: Exact classical prime Boolean and clause-product unary-automaton encoding antecedent; opaque discovery ID does not imply Schnitger coauthorship.
retained_primary_bodies.edition: MFCS 2003, LNCS 2747, pp.460–469 (actual title-page citation)

retained_primary_bodies.title: No Polynomial Bound for the Chip Firing Game on Directed Graphs
retained_primary_bodies.read: Complete three-page original including definitions, wheel construction and exponential terminating-game argument.
retained_primary_bodies.consequence: Long simple-graph games with polynomial initial chips already known; does not alone imply many-one NP-hardness.
retained_primary_bodies.edition: Proceedings of the AMS 112(4), August 1991, pp.1203–1205; retained AMS-hosted PDF

retained_primary_bodies.title: Primitive Periods in Greedy Chip-Firing Games
retained_primary_bodies.read: Model and version/title; entire ordinary sequential fixed-priority Section 4, Theorem 4.1 and full proof, PDF pp.8–10. Introductory hunger process is not silently identified with ordinary chips.
retained_primary_bodies.consequence: Active periodic orbit has primitive period; source explicitly leaves time to stabilize/enter orbit as a further question. No SAT halting classification proved by this read theorem.
retained_primary_bodies.edition: arXiv:2610.08949v1, byte rechecked through versioned URL

retained_primary_bodies.title: Target-oriented Petri Net Synthesis
retained_primary_bodies.authors: Eike Best; Raymond Devillers; Evgeny Erofeev; Harro Wimmel
retained_primary_bodies.read: Actual title/authors and class/synthesis interface only.
retained_primary_bodies.consequence: Wrong discovery label; not Hujsa–Devillers's missing weighted-net proof, never substituted for it. No theorem-exclusion inference from its title.
retained_primary_bodies.edition: Author manuscript with template first-page year; verified publication date UNKNOWN here

retained_primary_bodies.title: On the chip-firing halting problem for undirected multigraphs (within complete symposium proceedings)

retained_primary_bodies.edition: 10th Japanese–Hungarian Symposium on Discrete Mathematics and Its Applications, May 2017

retained_primary_bodies.title: The Computational Complexity of Sandpiles
retained_primary_bodies.read: Final-state prediction decision/output interfaces and relevant circuit simulation assumptions, selected primary-body portions.

retained_primary_bodies.title: Abelian networks IV. Dynamics of nonhalting networks

retained_primary_bodies.edition: Retained author-hosted manuscript
